intro: Wild Eyes is a Silverpine Forest quest where an ailing Forsaken scout seeks a cure to prevent a permanent second death. Frustrated by Apothecary Renferrel's ineffective heart-based concoctions, the scout tasks adventurers with gathering murloc eyes from Lake Lordamere to force a breakthrough in the apothecary's research.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.
If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The potion didn't work? Of course it didn't work. You brought me insufficient hearts. The recipe clearly calls for six. You brought three.
However, I confess I hadn't considered applications for murloc parts until now...
I can afford to sacrifice a few of my own hearts to get your Deathstalker's strength back.
